- Base colors: corners=g, plus tiles=W, center=g. "On" = brush color.
- Goal: set brush to **purple**, turn on the 4 plus tiles (→purple), keep center/corners off.
- I must find the slider state that yields a purple brush.

sections.label: TOOL CALL: python
sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>

def slider_full(frame):
    cells={}
    for n in frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        b=n['boundary']; rs=[p[0] for p in b]; cs=[p[1] for p in b]
        r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
        if 18<=r0<=23 and c0>12 and n['color'] in ('b','S') and n['pixels']<=12:
            cells[c0]=n['color']
    if not cells: return None
    lo=min(cells); return ''.join(cells.get(c,'.') for c in range(lo,lo+4)), lo
def rightedge(frame):
    a=frame.ascii.split('\n'); return sum(1 for r in a if r.rstrip().endswith(('W','N')))
print("timer rows:", rightedge(current_frame))
print("slider now:", slider_full(current_frame))
# reset center to off
action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':55,'col':30}])
print("center after click:", [n['color'] for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes'] if n['pixels']==9 and n['color'] in ('W','N','p','g') and 54<=min(p[0] for p in n['boundary'])<=56 and 29<=min(p[1] for p in n['boundary'])<=31])
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>

def slider_full(frame):
    cells={}
    for n in frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        b=n['boundary']; rs=[p[0] for p in b]; cs=[p[1] for p in b]
        r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
        if 18<=r0<=23 and c0>12 and n['color'] in ('b','S') and n['pixels']<=12:
            cells[c0]=n['color']
    if not cells: return None
    lo=min(cells); return ''.join(cells.get(c,'.') for c in range(lo,lo+4)), lo
def rightedge(frame):
    a=frame.ascii.split('\n'); return sum(1 for r in a if r.rstrip().endswith(('W','N')))
print("timer rows:", rightedge(current_frame))
print("slider now:", slider_full(current_frame))
# reset center to off
action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':55,'col':30}])
print("center after click:", [n['color'] for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes'] if n['pixels']==9 and n['color'] in ('W','N','p','g') and 54<=min(p[0] for p in n['boundary'])<=56 and 29<=min(p[1] for p in n['boundary'])<=31])
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
